# Identical hyperparams to Seed 1/3/4/5/6, only seed differs

defaults:

system:

micro_batch_size_per_gpu: 1
ppo_mini_batch_size: 16

trainer:

  experiment_name: exp029-seed7-episode-level

  test_freq: 5
  save_freq: 5

    override_config:
      attn_implementation: sdpa
  actor:
    fsdp_config:
      optimizer_offload: false
    use_ref: True
    use_torch_compile: False
    use_kl_loss: True
    kl_loss_coef: 0.01

    entropy_coeff: 0.001

    ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu: 65536

    gpu_memory_utilization: 0.35

    val_kwargs:
      do_sample: True
      temperature: 0.4

algorithm:
